# CC0 Environment Assets (Quaternius, 2018-2019)

All models by Quaternius (@Quaternius), released CC0 1.0 Universal.
Source: https://github.com/beep2bleep/FreeAssetsByKenneyNLandQuaternius
(FreeModels by Quaternius [Patreon] — License.txt in each pack confirms CC0)

Converted from FBX to GLB via FBX2glTF for AshLane runtime use.

- `street/` — 25 modular street pieces (roads, intersections, bridges, signs)
- `weapons/` — 24 low-poly weapons (axes, bows, daggers, swords)
- `props/` — 20 furniture pieces (beds, chairs, desks, doors — breakables)

Note: These are the older CC0 Quaternius packs. The newer Downtown City
MegaKit / Fantasy Props MegaKit are pending manual transfer (browser
download couldn't be captured).
